    # On Windows, ensure static linking is used.
    "@platforms//os:windows": ["YAML_CPP_STATIC_DEFINE", "YAML_CPP_NO_CONTRIB"],
    "//conditions:default": [],
})

cc_library(
    name = "yaml-cpp_internal",
    visibility = ["//:__subpackages__"],
    strip_include_prefix = "src",
    hdrs = glob(["src/**/*.h"]),
)

cc_library(
    name = "yaml-cpp",
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
    includes = ["include"],
    hdrs = glob(["include/**/*.h"]),
    srcs = glob(["src/**/*.cpp", "src/**/*.h"]),
    defines = yaml_cpp_defines,
)
replacements.after:
load("@rules_cc//cc:defs.bzl", "cc_library")
load("//src/io/yaml:sources.bzl", "YAML_SOURCES", "YAML_PRIVATE_HEADERS", "YAML_PUBLIC_HEADERS")

package(default_visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

_PREFIX = "src/chrono_thirdparty/yaml-cpp/"

# Reuse the vendor's existing implementation target as the sole native owner.
# The coherent Robodyna profile uses the retained static, contrib-enabled build.
cc_library(
    name = "headers",
    hdrs = [path[len(_PREFIX):] for path in YAML_PUBLIC_HEADERS],
    includes = ["include"],
    defines = ["YAML_CPP_STATIC_DEFINE"] + select({
        "@platforms//os:windows": ["YAML_CPP_NO_CONTRIB"],
        "//conditions:default": [],
    }),
)

cc_library(
    name = "yaml-cpp_internal",
    hdrs = [path[len(_PREFIX):] for path in YAML_PRIVATE_HEADERS],
    strip_include_prefix = "src",
    visibility = ["//:__subpackages__"],
)

cc_library(
    name = "yaml-cpp",
    srcs = [path[len(_PREFIX):] for path in YAML_SOURCES + YAML_PRIVATE_HEADERS],
    deps = [":headers"],
    copts = ["-O3", "-fPIC"],
)

exports_files(["CMakeLists.txt", "LICENSE"])

// The outer C# interface owns its chrono_ros module name.
#ifdef SWIGPYTHON
%module(directors="1") ros
#endif
